'''Makuta no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' (馬来田国造, also read as Umakuta no Kuni no Miyatsuko or Makuta Kokuzō) was a {{ill|Kuni no miyatsuko|es|Kuni no miyatsuko|ff|Kuni no miyatsuko|it|Kuni no miyatsuko|ja|国造|ko|국조 (일본)|simple|Kuni no miyatsuko|vi|Kuni no miyatsuko|zh|國造|qid=Q2483673|lt=kuni no miyatsuko}}, a regional ruler, governing the central-western part of the {{ill|Kazusa Province|en|Kazusa Province|qid=Q1055394|lt=Kazusa Province}}.

== Overview ==

=== Ancestry ===
According to the {{ill|Kujiki|en|Kujiki|qid=Q2716751|lt=Sendai Kuji Hongi}} ("Chronicle of the Country's Ancient Matters"), under the reign of Emperor {{ill|Emperor Seimu|en|Emperor Seimu|qid=Q316672|lt=Seimu}}, {{ill|Fukakawa-no-Oyami no Mikoto|ja|深河意弥命}}, a descendant of {{ill|Amatsuhikone|fa|آماتسوهیکونه|fr|Amatsuhikone|it|Amatsuhikone|ja|アマツヒコネ|zh|天津日子根命|qid=Q10940228}} and the ancestor of the {{ill|Q11617300|ja|茨城国造|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11617300}}, was appointed as the first ruler of the Makuta region.

=== Clan ===
The ruling clan is believed to have been the {{ill|Kashiwade no Ōtomo-be Clan|ja|膳大伴部氏}} (かしわでのおおともべうじ). Their hereditary title (kabane) is unknown.

== Base of Power ==

=== Territory ===
The Makuta no Kuni no Miyatsuko ruled a region historically known as "Makuta no Kuni," corresponding to the {{ill|Mōda district|ja|望陀郡|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11517166}} of Kazusa Province. This area covers present-day {{ill|Sodegaura|ar|سوديغوارا (تشيبا)|arz|سوديجوارا|azb|سودقائورا، چیبا|ce|Содегаура|ceb|Sodegaura-shi|de|Sodegaura|eo|Sodegaura|es|Sodegaura (Chiba)|fa|سودگائورا، چیبا|fi|Sodegaura|fr|Sodegaura|gl|Sodegaura|id|Sodegaura, Chiba|it|Sodegaura|ja|袖ケ浦市|ko|소데가우라시|mzn|سودگائورا، چیبا|nl|Sodegaura|pl|Sodegaura|pt|Sodegaura|ro|Sodegaura|ru|Содегаура|simple|Sodegaura|sv|Sodegaura|sw|Sodegaura, Chiba|tg|Содегаура|th|โซเดงาอูระ|tl|Sodegaura|tr|Sodegaura|tt|Содегаура|tum|Sodegaura|uk|Содеґаура|ur|سودیگاورا، چیبا|uz|Sodegaura|vi|Sodegaura, Chiba|war|Sodegaura, Chiba|zh|袖浦市|zh_classical|袖浦市|zh_min_nan|Sodegaura-chhī|zh_yue|袖浦|qid=Q646847|lt=Sodegaura}} in its entirety, most of {{ill|Kisarazu|en|Kisarazu|qid=Q335427|lt=Kisarazu}}, and parts of {{ill|Kimitsu|en|Kimitsu|qid=Q637928|lt=Kimitsu}} and {{ill|Kamogawa, Chiba|en|Kamogawa, Chiba|qid=Q387211|lt=Kamogawa}}. The {{ill|Gion‐Nagasuka Kofun Group|ja|祇園・長須賀古墳群|lt=Gion-Nagasuka Kofun Cluster|qid=Q11588419}}, including the {{ill|Kinreizuka Kofun|ja|金鈴塚古墳|qid=Q11647959}}, was constructed under the authority of the Makuta rulers.

== Clan Deity ==
The identity of the clan's tutelary deity is unknown.

=== Burial Sites ===
* '''{{ill|Iitsubo Kofun|ja|飯籠塚古墳}}'''
: Located in Kimitsu City, Chiba Prefecture, this keyhole-shaped kofun measures 102 meters in length and dates to the {{ill|4th century|en|4th century|qid=Q8099|lt=4th century}}.
* '''{{ill|Asama Shrine Kofun|ja|箕輪浅間神社古墳}}'''
: Situated in Kimitsu City, this kofun is 105 meters long and also dates to the 4th century.
* '''{{ill|Hakusan Shrine|ja|白山神社古墳 (君津市)|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 白山神社 (君津市)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11579592}}'''
: Located in Kimitsu City, this kofun measures 89 meters in length and was built during the 4th century.
* '''{{ill|Gion‐Nagasuka Kofun Group|ja|祇園・長須賀古墳群|lt=Gion-Nagasuka Kofun Cluster|qid=Q11588419}}'''
: This cluster of Kofuns in Kisarazu City was constructed between the mid-5th and 7th centuries.
